newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: USDA said trade was fairly active late Tuesday. Slaughter steers and heifers closed $2.00 higher than last week.

Inquiry was good, demand was fairly good. Sales confirmed on 14,100 slaughter steers and 13,400 slaughter heifers. For the week to date 31,300 head confirmed including 4,600 head or about 15 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Steers - select and choice 2-3 1050-1300 lbs, mostly 1150-1200 lbs 69.00, few select with end choice including cutting bulls 68.50-69.00; pen Select and Choice 1200 lbs Holsteins 62.00.
Heifers - select and choice 2-3 980-1100 lbs 69.00, pen
950 lbs 68.00; few mixed commerical to choice 1100-1250 lb
week to date: 31300 week ago: 30500 year ago: 26000
